cause_quote: The new `.new-session-page__composer > .agent-chat__input::after` selector applied `opacity: 0` to the pseudo-element that draws the recording border.
user_saw: When users started dictation in New Session, the animated recording border was missing.
summary: The fix moved the image-drop tint to `::before`, restoring the animated dictation border on `::after`.
reasoning: I checked the parent of #200758 and confirmed that New Session already supported dictation, the shared composer drew its recording border on the input’s `::after`, and the drop tint used the outer composer’s `::after`. The #200758 diff moved the tint onto the input’s `::after` with a more specific selector, and the fix PR reports that the browser test measured opacity 0 before the repair.
